reason: LessWrong, the Alignment Forum, and the EA Forum expose a public GraphQL API. robots.txt disallows /graphiql, not /graphql. Posts are first-person essays with a structured author slug, canonical URL, and pagination by offset. This is the densest missing source of attributable forecasts. Offset is capped at 2000 by the API.

public.api.bsky.app allows public reads, needs no key, paginates with a cursor, and returns post text plus a language code. Handles are admitted only from a page already linked to the person. The Mila organization account is kept separate.
youtube.com/robots.txt disallows /feeds/videos.xml. The Data API needs a key this repository does not have. No adapter was written.
Public RSS already collects Substack feeds. One registered feed, sethlazar.substack.com/feed, redirects to an HTML profile and stays invalid_content. A second archive API would mostly duplicate RSS.
The existing corpus already records speaker_labels_absent on show pages. Transcript attribution belongs with the extraction workstream.
No stable official API with a clear rights path was verified in this pass. YouTube captions are disallowed by robots.txt.
